camel_example: aliyun alb RemoveServersFromServerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Servers.1.ServerType Ecs --Servers.1.ServerId 'i-bp1f9kdprbgy9uiu0000' --Servers.1.Port 80 --ServerGroupId 'sgp-atstuj3rtop0000' --Servers.1.ServerIp '192.168.1.1' --method POST --force
description_en: Removes backend servers from a server group
description_zh: 从服务器组中移除后端服务器
kebab_example: aliyun alb remove-servers-from-server-group --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtop0000 --servers ServerType=Ecs ServerId=i-bp1f9kdprbgy9uiu0000 Port=80 ServerIp=192.168.1.1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveServersFromServerGroup

fields.help_en:
The port that is used by the backend server. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

This parameter is required when you set ServerType to Ecs, Eni, Eci, or Ip
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器使用的端口。取值范围：1~65535。
当ServerType取值为Ecs、Eni、Eci、Ip时，该参数必传
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The backend server ID.

If the server group is of the Instance type, set ServerId to the ID of a resource of the Ecs, Eni, or Eci type.

If the server group is of the Ip type, set this parameter to IP addresses.

If the server group is of the Fc type, set ServerId to the Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of a function.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2254862.html operation to query information about the server group type so that you can set ServerId to a proper value
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器ID。

当服务器组为Instance类型时，该参数为Ecs、Eni、Eci资源ID。

当服务器组为Ip类型时，该参数为IP地址。

当服务器组为Fc类型时，该参数为函数计算的ARN标识。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2254862.html接口获取服务器组类型的取值
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en: The IP address of the elastic network interface (ENI) in inclusive mode
fields.name: server_ip

fields.help_en:
The type of the backend server. Valid values:

Ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance

Eni: ENI

Eci: elastic container instance

Ip: IP address

Fc: Function Compute instance
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型。取值：
Ecs：ECS实例。
Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。
Eci：ECI弹性容器。
Ip：IP地址。
Fc：函数计算
fields.name: server_type

parameters.help_en: The backend servers to be removed. You can specify up to 200 backend servers
parameters.help_zh: 后端服务器组列表，最多支持200个服务器
parameters.name: servers

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会从服务器组中移除后端服务器。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
